svg.aria-label: Dominik, thaDoom. Full-stack web developer, self-taught, Veneto, Italy. Available now. Figure 1 maps 2026 day by day: Call-centre CRM, 21 commits from 17 Feb to 2 Apr; Company website rebuild, 53 commits from 2 Mar to 8 Apr; Market-stall stock app, 19 commits from 14 Jun to 29 Oct; Game community platform, 81 commits from 19 Oct to 6 Nov; Ombra, 9 releases from 5 Nov to 14 Nov. 9 releases shipped in 10 days. 475 automated tests all passing. 44 API routes on Postgres + Redis. 2 real businesses I built for.
